transformations.description: Copies route and pattern objects exactly from the five accepted radial component scenarios, orders routes numerically R1-R12, and unions StopNodes and StopPlaces by stable municipal-code-derived ID. Any complete-object conflict is a hard failure.

Includes only StopNodes referenced by the copied radial route patterns and only their referenced StopPlaces. Stop arrays are serialized in ascending numeric municipal-code order; no proximity, name or coordinate merge is performed.
Copies each component route style exactly, combines them in numerical route order, and provides one whole-network initial view. Presentation metadata creates no graph semantics.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes all asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from serialized bytes.

warnings: This is a pure merge of accepted radial components; no route sequence, pattern, municipal identity, coordinate or StopPlace mapping was rediscovered or normalized during the merge.

Component settlement center/bounds differ because they describe component extents. The final es-elche settlement retains the stable accepted identity fields and derives whole-network center/bounds from all merged routed StopPlaces.
The included route scope is exactly R1-R12. Urban/non-radial routes A-L and NT, seasonal P1-P3 services, and special nocturnal N/NP services are excluded.
R10 base and event/IFA patterns are preserved exactly from elche-radial-airport-v1.
R11 Carrús and Sector V patterns are preserved exactly from elche-radial-airport-v1; the lower-confidence diagram-derived Sector V review boundary remains inherited.
R12 uses the current ordered Gran Via/Bahia circulation preserved from elche-radial-coast-v1; its disagreement with the supplied older diagram remains inherited.

Municipal stops 355 and 026 remain distinct identities. The radial all scenario routes 355 where its accepted radial component patterns do so and does not import non-routed 026 merely because of the shared Hospital General destination name.
Internal directed cycles and non-consecutive repeated StopNodes remain exactly as represented by the accepted component patterns. closesLoop adds only each pattern final-to-first edge.
Previously identified grandfathered Torrevieja sourceReferences fields remain untouched by explicit user instruction.
